source.quicksale: Pax premium according to the current tariff, non-binding. Switching requires a health check.
source.estimate: Pax premium estimated, non-binding. Switching requires a health check.
source.logismata: Tax saving calculated with Logismata, without guarantee.
source.ruleOfThumb: Rule of thumb: about three gross annual incomes. We calculate the exact gap with you in a conversation.
source.ivMax: Calculated with the maximum IV pension. The actual pension is often lower.

cheaper_equivalent.title: The same cover is available for less
cheaper_equivalent.body: You pay {externalPremium} a year for your policy with {insurer}. The same cover costs about {paxPremium} at the Pax tariff, roughly {saving} less. Only cancel once the new cover is confirmed.

coverage_mismatch_death.title: Death cover is on the low side
coverage_mismatch_death.body: Today {cover} would be paid out on death. As a rule of thumb, a family needs about three annual incomes, here around {need}. Have the gap calculated precisely in a conversation.

coverage_mismatch_death_without_dependan.title: Death cover without dependants
coverage_mismatch_death_without_dependan.body: You pay for a lump sum on death of {cover}, although nobody currently depends on your income. Check whether you still need it, for example for a mortgage.

coverage_mismatch_disability.title: Gap if you can no longer work
coverage_mismatch_disability.body: If you were unable to work for a long time, about {gap} a year would be missing to reach 80 percent of today's income, even with the IV and the pension fund. The IV pension is calculated at its maximum.

double_cover_indemnity.title: Insured twice
double_cover_indemnity.body: Two contracts cover the same damage, but a loss is only paid once. Together they cost {premiumTotal} a year. Check which contract you want to keep.

double_cover_personal.title: Two contracts for the same risk
double_cover_personal.body: The same person has two contracts with different insurers ({premiumTotal} a year). That may be intended. One contract for the whole sum is often cheaper, though.

pillar3a_not_maxed.title: Pillar 3a not used to the full
pillar3a_not_maxed.body: You pay {contribution} a year into pillar 3a; {limit} is allowed. Every franc up to the maximum lowers your taxable income and strengthens your retirement savings.

pillar3a_not_maxed_unknown.title: Pillar 3a: up to {limit} a year
pillar3a_not_maxed_unknown.body: Every year you can pay up to {limit} into pillar 3a and deduct it from your taxable income. We don't know yet whether you already do.

pension_buyin.title: A pension fund buy-in saves tax
pension_buyin.body: According to your pension certificate you can pay up to {maxBuyIn} into your pension fund. Spread over {years} years you save about {taxSavings} in tax. After a buy-in, no lump-sum withdrawal is possible for three years.

pension_buyin_no_tax.title: Pension fund buy-in possible
pension_buyin_no_tax.body: According to your pension certificate you can pay up to {maxBuyIn} into your pension fund. A buy-in is deductible from taxable income and increases your retirement benefits.

contract_ending_notice.title: Notice deadline on {date}
contract_ending_notice.body: You can cancel {product} with {insurer} until {date}. If you do nothing, the contract continues. Now is a good moment to check whether it still fits.

contract_ending_end.title: {product} ends on {date}
contract_ending_end.body: After that this cover no longer exists. Check whether you still need it.

dates.title: Upcoming dates
dates.empty: No deadlines in the next two years.
